# T-3: Migrate bulk surface

## Goal
Move retained `update-all` behavior to `update` without args and make help output advertise the new command surface.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `update` without args preserves enabled-package result rendering and automatic upgrade run/skip behavior.
- Help output documents `senti plugin update [name]`.
- `update-all` is not advertised and invoking it fails without updating plugin package state.

## Implementation Notes
Update `src/lib/command-registry.js` and affected help tests. Remove the old route as a compatibility path and include a behavior-level test that `update-all` exits non-zero without updating package state.

## Test Strategy
Update shared help regression and add spec-local behavior tests for migrated bulk output.
